# Overview

This notebook visualises the results of differential transcription factor (DTF)
consensus clustering. It continues from `02_DTF_ConsensusClustering.R`, which
produced the mean chromVAR z-score deviation matrix (DTFs × dASPs).

Consensus clustering (ConsensusClusterPlus, k-means, k = 1–25) is applied to
the DTF matrix to identify reproducible TF sets. The optimal k is selected by
inspecting the consensus CDF and delta-area plots output by the run. Results
are visualised as:

  - A heatmap of all DTFs ordered by consensus cluster, coloured by dASP
  - A condensed heatmap showing the average expression per consensus cluster
  - Per-cluster individual TF heatmaps (one per consensus cluster)

---

---

# USER CONFIGURATION

```{r config}
# Input: consensus matrix from 02_DTF_ConsensusClustering.R
path.cc.matrix <- "/path/to/Tables/Chromvar_CISBP_ClusterPseudobulk/ConsensusDTFlist.ClusterPB.k4.rds"

# Input: all DTF calls (for optional volcano plots)
path.dtf.list  <- "/path/to/Tables/Chromvar_CISBP_ClusterPseudobulk/DTFList.allClustersPB.k4.PTregressed.rds"

# Directory where ConsensusClusterPlus writes its PNG output files
dir.cc.output  <- "/path/to/Tables/Chromvar_CISBP_ClusterPseudobulk/"

# Output PDF
path.output.pdf <- "/path/to/Plots/PB_DTF_CC_byTrajCluster.pdf"

# Consensus clustering parameters
CC_MAX_K    <- 25      # max k to test
CC_REPS     <- 10      # number of subsampling replicates
CC_P_ITEM   <- 0.8     # fraction of items (TFs) to subsample per replicate
CC_SEED     <- 1262118388.71279

# Selected k (set after inspecting the CDF / delta-area plots from CC run)
# Update this after examining the ConsensusClusterPlus output PNGs
SELECTED_K  <- 10

# dASP column labels for heatmap (update if dASP identities have been renamed)
DASP_LABELS <- c("Bi-directional", "HSPC/Myeloid",
                  "Immature/Mature-B", "Mature-B")

# Heatmap colour limits
HEATMAP_LIMITS <- c(-1, 1)
```

---

## Load data

```{r load-data}
cc.matrix <- readRDS(path.cc.matrix)
dtfs      <- readRDS(path.dtf.list)

cat("DTF matrix dimensions:", nrow(cc.matrix), "TFs ×",
    ncol(cc.matrix), "dASPs\n")
```

---

## Run ConsensusClusterPlus

```{r consensus-clustering}
# ConsensusClusterPlus requires features as rows, samples as columns.
# Our matrix has DTFs as rows and dASPs as columns, so transpose before running.
current.matrix <- t(cc.matrix)

setwd(dir.cc.output)

cc_run <- ConsensusClusterPlus(
  current.matrix,
  reps        = CC_REPS,
  pItem       = CC_P_ITEM,
  pFeature    = 1,
  clusterAlg  = "km",
  seed        = CC_SEED,
  plot        = "png",
  writeTable  = TRUE,
  maxK        = CC_MAX_K,
  distance    = "euclidean",
  title       = "Pseudobulk_CC"
)

cat("Consensus clustering complete. PNG output in:", dir.cc.output, "\n")
cat("Inspect delta-area plots to confirm SELECTED_K =", SELECTED_K, "\n")
```

---

## Load consensus cluster assignments and build ordered heatmaps

```{r load-cc-assignments}
# Load the consensus class assignments for the selected k
cc.csv.path <- file.path(dir.cc.output, "Pseudobulk_CC",
                           paste0("Pseudobulk_CC.k=", SELECTED_K,
                                  ".consensusClass.csv"))

tf.order <- read.csv(cc.csv.path, col.names = c("TF", "CC")) %>%
  arrange(CC)

# Align LFC matrix to the TF order from CC
lfc.matrix <- cc.matrix %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(rn = rownames(.))

tf.indices <- match(tf.order$TF, rownames(lfc.matrix))
lfc.matrix <- lfc.matrix[tf.indices, 1:4]  # keep dASP columns only
```

---

## Compute per-consensus-cluster average expression

```{r avg-expression}
avg.exp <- cc.matrix %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(rn = rownames(.)) %>%
  left_join(tf.order, by = c("rn" = "TF")) %>%
  group_by(CC) %>%
  mutate(tf_count = n()) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # Rank consensus clusters by mean expression across dASPs (descending)
  mutate(avg_val  = rowMeans(across(as.character(1:4))),
         avg_rank = rank(-avg_val)) %>%
  arrange(avg_rank)

tf.order <- tf.order %>%
  left_join(avg.exp %>% dplyr::select(CC, avg_rank), by = "CC") %>%
  arrange(avg_rank)

# Row labels for average heatmap: "Consensus Cluster X: N TFs"
row_labels <- paste0("TF Set ", avg.exp$CC, ": ",
                      avg.exp$tf_count, " TFs")

cat("Consensus clusters (ranked by avg expression):\n")
print(avg.exp %>% dplyr::select(CC, tf_count, avg_rank))
```

---

## Heatmap: all DTFs ordered by consensus cluster

```{r full-heatmap, fig.width=4, fig.height=8}
pdf(path.output.pdf, height = 6, width = 4)

# Full DTF heatmap ordered by CC
pheatmap(lfc.matrix[match(tf.order$TF, rownames(lfc.matrix)), ],
         main             = "DTF Consensus Clustering",
         color            = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(9, "RdBu")))(100),
         breaks           = seq(HEATMAP_LIMITS[1], HEATMAP_LIMITS[2], length = 100),
         cluster_rows     = FALSE,
         cluster_cols     = FALSE,
         gaps_row         = which(!!diff(tf.order$CC)),
         show_colnames    = TRUE,
         show_rownames    = FALSE,
         labels_col       = DASP_LABELS,
         fontsize         = 8)

# Average expression heatmap (one row per consensus cluster)
avg.exp.plot <- avg.exp %>%
  dplyr::select(as.character(1:4)) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(avg.exp.plot) <- row_labels

pheatmap(avg.exp.plot,
         main          = "Average DTF Expression by TF Set",
         color         = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(9, "RdBu")))(100),
         breaks        = seq(HEATMAP_LIMITS[1], HEATMAP_LIMITS[2], length = 100),
         cluster_rows  = FALSE,
         cluster_cols  = FALSE,
         show_colnames = TRUE,
         show_rownames = TRUE,
         labels_col    = DASP_LABELS,
         fontsize      = 8)
```

---

## Per-TF-set individual heatmaps

```{r per-set-heatmaps, fig.width=4, fig.height=6}
n_sets <- length(unique(tf.order$CC))

for (j in seq_len(n_sets)) {
  set.tfs <- tf.order$TF[tf.order$avg_rank == j]

  pheatmap(lfc.matrix[set.tfs, , drop = FALSE],
           main             = paste0("TF Set ", j),
           color            = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(9, "RdBu")))(100),
           breaks           = seq(HEATMAP_LIMITS[1], HEATMAP_LIMITS[2], length = 100),
           cluster_rows     = FALSE,
           cluster_cols     = FALSE,
           show_colnames    = TRUE,
           show_rownames    = TRUE,
           labels_col       = DASP_LABELS,
           cellwidth        = 40,
           cellheight       = 8,
           fontsize         = 8)
}

dev.off()
cat("Heatmaps saved to:", path.output.pdf, "\n")
```
